messages:
ci-bot: [publish-job #7821] ❌ push to registry failed: 400 Bad Request - manifest mediaType mismatch (expected 'application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json')
aline: saw this on the canary publish too, started after we bumped kaniko image to v1.11 last night :thinking_face:
devon: can you paste the full kaniko logs? I'm guessing kaniko produced an OCI manifest but the registry wants docker v2 mediaType.
aline: log excerpt: `INFO: created manifest with mediaType: application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json` then `error response from daemon: manifest invalid: mediaType not supported`
kai: ah, we changed IMAGE_FORMAT env in the pipeline to `oci` to test smaller tarballs. forgot registry is picky for this repo. quick fix is to force docker manifest type in kaniko.
devon: yeah kaniko supports `--manifest-type` since v1.10? try `--manifest-type docker` or set `DOCKER_MEDIA_TYPE=v2` in buildpack.
aline: can someone do a quick rerun with that flag? CI job is `publish-canary-us-east-2`
kai: running a rerun now with `--manifest-type docker` on the kaniko step. kicking it off. :rocket:
ci-bot: re-run started (job 7821.2) — will report back
devon: while that's running, to validate existing pushed blobs we can query the registry:```bash
curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json" \
  -I https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/redwood/canary/manifests/sha256:<digest>
```
aline: good idea. registry returned `Content-Type: application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json` for the older manifest, and `Content-Type: application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json` for the failed artifact. so registry accepts v2 but refuses OCI for this repo.
sre-bot: registry logs show: `repository redwood/canary: manifest upload rejected — unsupported mediaType application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json` from the storage plugin. filing internal issue RREG-482.
devon: thanks. short term: pin kaniko to v1.9 in the release pipeline or force `--manifest-type docker` in kaniko args. longer term: update registry storage plugin to accept OCI manifests (tracking in RREG-482).
kai: rerun finished: success ✅ with `--manifest-type docker`. pushed manifest v2. can confirm new manifest shows `Content-Type: application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json`
aline: OK will open a tiny PR to add `--manifest-type docker` to the publish step and pin kaniko in stable pipeline. @devon can you review?
devon: on it. also tagging @sre-bot to follow up on RREG-482 and see if it's safe to broaden accepted types.
sre-bot: will take it, starting triage. initial cause: repo configured with strict mediaType whitelist after storage upgrade last month. RREG-482 assigned to gregory for follow-up.
aline: if anyone hits this locally, workaround: add `--manifest-type docker` to kaniko or downgrade to `gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:v1.9.0`
kai: adding note to runbook under eng-infra/publish: "kaniko->registry mediaType mismatch — force docker manifest or use v1.9"
aline: thanks all. leaving the canary to run for a couple hours. if no regressions we merge the flag to main. :thumbsup:
